description: A `!` function passed as an event-handler REFERENCE: the bare `onclick=risky`, the `${}` `onclick=${risky}`, and a bare reference inside an `<errorBoundary>`. The event dispatcher would call `risky` and discard its error, exactly like `onclick=risky()`. E-ERROR-002 fires once per handler — three times; the boundary does not contain a handler (§19.6.6).
rationale: §19.4.3 (S441) — a failable function passed as a handler reference SHALL be E-ERROR-002, the same as the call form; §19.6.6 — an `<errorBoundary>` catches render-time calls only.
